Yes, agents please.

Some or all of the code in this project was written with help from AI: coding agents, LLM chat, autocomplete, or a mix. Pull requests made the same way are welcome here too.

The only ask

  • You understand what you're sending and can answer questions about it.
  • You ran it, and it works.
  • If an agent or LLM did most of the work, a quick note in the PR is nice. Not required.

Add a badge

Pick one and drop it in your README to point folks here:
